title: jasminum trifoliatum
intro: Jasminum trifoliatum, commonly known as the star jasmine or three-leaf jasmine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, potentially aiding in the management of conditions such as fever and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Jasminum trifoliatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities. Additionally, the plant's leaves and flowers are used in traditional remedies due to their potential to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues.
